done_when: forge sync writes every generated file in any worktree, whatever other worktrees hold, and never refuses for another worktree's spec

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test. The named proof can pass while sync omits generated files: it derives the expected set from sync’s own `Wrote` output, then checks only that set. `src/forge/sync.py:362-378` shows that generated files come from multiple `ships()` providers, so writing just the two guides would satisfy the test. The test also removes the original spec worktree at line 33 before syncing, leaving no second active spec worktree to exercise the stated case.
findings.title: Not done: the command-level sync proof

why: forge sync still refuses in a worktree when another worktree holds a copy of a spec, so builders copy the guide by hand into both host skill files
